z1.caption: Furniture & Home Décor Products
z1.desc: Furniture and home décor at big discounts. Shop to your heart's content with quality products brought together for special deals, with beautiful designs at the best value.

z2.caption: Solar Cells & Smart Home Products
z2.desc: Save on electricity, stay safe, and keep your budget happy with alternative energy. Enjoy special prices on smart home devices and solar cells, with all the cutting-edge home technology you need in one event.

z3.caption: Home Building & Design Services
z3.desc: Home-building and prefab packages at attractive prices, with exclusive promotions and freebies available only at this event. No more worries about budget overruns. Close the deal easily and get your home with confidence.

z4.caption: Electronics & Home Conveniences
z4.desc: A big year-end sale on electrical appliances, with special discounts on top brands. Make housework easy. There's no better value than this, so don't miss out!

z5.caption: Plants, Gardening & Outdoor Products
z5.desc: Great promotions on plants and garden décor. Shop to your heart's content with special discounts on gardening supplies and create a beautiful garden on a budget.

z6.caption: Lifestyle Product, Art & Craft
z6.desc: Enjoy browsing home accents and art pieces at friendly prices, with special promotions exclusive to the event. Find items you love at easy-to-pay prices, all in one place.

z7.caption: Food, Beverage & Lounge Zone
z7.desc: Enjoy moments of happiness and delicious food. Stop by for your favorite dishes and a cozy seating area, and recharge before you continue shopping.

z8.caption: Power Buy EXPO
z8.desc: Unbeatable deals! Up to 50% off, plus top-up discounts and 0% installments for up to 24 months with participating cards. Great value on home appliances, only at this event!
